settings.content: Label facts for the Mush Gummies. Used on the product page, ingredients and label sections whenever the product's own nurellea.* metafields are empty. Must match the printed label exactly.

settings.label: Highlight pills
settings.info: Comma-separated, e.g. Vegan, Non-GMO, Lab tested

settings.label: Buy box checklist
settings.info: One line per point. Use compliant wording (e.g. "traditionally used to…", "supports…").

settings.label: Serving size
settings.info: e.g. 2 gummies

settings.label: Facts rows
settings.info: One ingredient per line: Name | Amount | % Daily Value

settings.label: Mush Gummies product
settings.info: Single source of truth for price, variants, stock and product facts used across the homepage, ingredients and FAQ sections. Sections can override it.

settings.content: Business details and offers shown to customers. Leave a field blank until it is confirmed — blank fields are hidden on the storefront rather than filled with guesses.

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Shown on Contact, FAQ, order status and policy pages.

settings.label: Support hours
settings.info: Example: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm ET

settings.label: Typical reply time
settings.info: Only fill in if you can commit to it. Example: within 1 business day

settings.label: Business address
settings.info: Used on Contact and legal pages.

settings.content: Only enable offers your store actually honours. Prices, discounts and stock always come from Shopify product data and checkout — never from these fields.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold (store currency, whole units)
settings.info: Must match your Shopify shipping rates. Leave blank to hide all free-shipping messaging.

settings.label: Guarantee headline
settings.info: Example: 30-day satisfaction guarantee. Must match your refund policy. Leave blank to hide.

settings.label: Shipping & delivery summary
settings.info: Shown in the product page Shipping & returns panel. Example: Orders are processed in 2–4 days, then delivered in 5–12 business days. Leave blank to show a link to the shipping policy only.

settings.label: Ship time next to Add to cart
settings.info: Example: Ships in 2–4 days. Must match your real processing time. Leave blank to hide.

settings.label: Offer subscriptions
settings.info: Requires a subscription app that creates selling plans, and a checkout that supports them. Plans only appear on products that have them.

settings.label: Manage subscription link
settings.info: Customer portal URL from your subscription app.

settings.label: Skip cart and send shoppers straight to checkout
settings.info: Legacy behaviour from the previous store. When off, shoppers use the cart drawer and cart page.

settings.label: Show “Write a review” form
settings.info: Submissions are emailed to the store via the Shopify contact form for moderation. Nothing is published automatically.

settings.label: Show labelled sample reviews in the theme editor
settings.info: Design preview only. Samples never render on the live storefront and are never included in structured data.

settings.label: Primary storefront domain
settings.info: Example: www.nurellea.com. Pages served from any other host (preview, myshopify.com, staging) are marked noindex.

settings.label: Keep entire storefront out of search results
settings.info: Use for staging or before launch.

settings.label: Fallback meta description
settings.info: Used when a page has no description of its own. Keep under 160 characters.

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: 1200 × 630 px recommended. Falls back to the bundled Nurellea image.

settings.label: Label placeholder images
settings.info: Adds a small “Placeholder” tag to illustrated stand-ins until real photography is uploaded.

settings.label: Load legacy jQuery and vendor scripts
settings.info: Render-blocking scripts from the previous theme. Enable only if an installed app requires jQuery.

settings.content: Only add verified Nurellea profiles. Used in the footer and Organization structured data.

settings.label: Supplement disclaimer (footer + product page)
settings.info: Confirm the wording required for your selling markets with your compliance advisor.
settings.default: Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied, balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have a medical condition, consult your doctor before use. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

settings.content: Routes cart checkout and Buy Now buttons to the Phoenix external checkout and fires its checkout_load / failed_to_redirect events plus the Meta CAPI InitiateCheckout beacon. When disabled or the URL is blank, shoppers use native Shopify checkout.

settings.label: Phoenix checkout URL
settings.info: Nurellea’s own checkout domain, starting with https://. Never reuse another store’s checkout domain.

settings.label: Allow-listed product IDs
settings.info: Comma-separated Shopify product IDs. Used only when Route is set to allow-list.

options.label: Checkout with only the selected variant
Clear cart, add one unit, checkout

settings.content: Connects the Track your order page to App Manager (https://appmanager.store). Copy the Nurellea Store ID from App Manager → Tracking → Shopify connection. Until it is set, the page shows a “not configured” message instead of querying another store.

settings.label: App Manager API URL
settings.info: Base URL only — no trailing slash and no /api/track-order (e.g. https://appmanager.store).

settings.label: App Manager Store ID
settings.info: Nurellea store UUID from App Manager → Tracking → Shopify connection.

settings.content: Sends the Meta funnel to App Manager (PageView, ViewContent, Search, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout + Attribution cache). Purchase stays server-side from Shopify order webhooks. Copy the Nurellea Store ID and browser token from App Manager → Server-Side Tracking → Settings. No events are sent until both are set.

settings.label: App Manager Store ID
settings.info: Falls back to the Order tracking Store ID if left blank.

settings.label: Browser event token
settings.info: Required. From App Manager → Server-Side Tracking → Settings. Without this token, funnel events are not sent.
